Not just anonymization

Privacy decisions should understand why the data will be used.

MedNexus is a Clinical Privacy Policy Engine, not a simple anonymizer. The same medical document may require different privacy decisions depending on whether it is being used for care delivery, research, analytics, public health, or maximum privacy.

“What should we remove?”
→“What should we protect — and what clinical value must we preserve?”
Purpose-based clinical privacy

One engine.
Four intentions.

Choose the purpose first. The unified MedNexus intelligence pipeline remains the same; the selected policy determines how accepted identity signals are transformed in the final protected output.

Architecture

    
Detection is only
the beginning.

    
MedNexus owns contextual interpretation, role resolution, validation, privacy decisions and final protected output construction. External detection engines contribute candidate signals; they do not own the final document.

    

      
01
Medical DocumentText or extracted document content

      
02
Multi-source DetectionDeterministic, contextual and external candidate signals

      
03
MedNexus Intelligence CoreCanonicalization, roles, validation and merging

Clinical Privacy Policy EnginePurpose-based transformation decisions

Protected Clinical InformationMedNexus-owned final output
